name: test-stage
about: The test stage (ticket #198): Joe's foreground (USA, its colour rows 0-4 in place) over Geki's background (Japan) with its tiles copied into the bank and its colour rows 0 and 8 moved to 12 and 13, on page 1 at the scroll words of Retsu's stage. Every pixel is a ROM pixel; the arrangement is new. Pickable in tests and with sf-game's --stage, never listed for players.
